levels.name: Recognise
levels.evidence: Learner can identify length in the chapter context.

levels.name: Explain
levels.evidence: Learner can explain length and connect it to distance without copying source wording.

levels.name: Apply
levels.evidence: Learner can use measurement units in a familiar new situation.

levels.name: Transfer
levels.evidence: Learner can solve or explain an unfamiliar situation using several ideas from Far and Near and justify the response.

levels.name: Create
levels.evidence: Learner can create a new example, question, model, investigation or explanation based on Far and Near.

progressionRule: Move upward only when the learner demonstrates the current level independently and can explain the reasoning.
